Mariagerfjord is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, relying on data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

In the context of this report, Mariagerfjord is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's specific data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is presented in a detailed table on page 95, allowing for local quality development and benchmarking against national and regional metrics [^src1]. As the current corpus only contains a single tabular mention of the municipality, no further claims, relationships, or timeline events are available.
